en: A vintage black‑and‑white studio portrait of a young woman lying on the floor, propped on one arm, facing the camera. She wears a large, wide‑brimmed hat and a dark dress or cloak decorated with patterned stripes and a large bow at the neck. In front of her on the floor are scattered playing cards. The background is a plain studio backdrop and there is no visible printed text or border on the image side.
